Suicide bombing in Pakistan kills at least 15, including soldiers

A suicide bombing occurred in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, resulting in multiple fatalities. Reports indicate that at least 15 people died, with some sources stating the number of deceased is higher. The attack, which involved a car bomb, has been claimed by the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP). The incident highlights ongoing security challenges in the region.
